text:
nora (Finance): FYI vendor Meridian Analytics (SG) sent INV-2026-204 charging 11% PPN (Indonesian VAT) and are asking us to gross-up net amount. Payment will be wired to their SG account. Anyone seen this pattern for Indonesia digital services?
diego (Accounting): They charged PPN but are SG-entity? That sounds off. Indonesia PPN for imported services usually either self-assessed by recipient (reverse charge) or charged by vendor if they have local VAT reg (PKP). We need proof of PKP registration (NPWP/PKP number) or a reseller chain.
raj_supplier (Vendor): Hi team 44b We were asked by our Indonesian distributor to invoice with PPN. We can reissue without PPN if you confirm reverse-charge. They asked us to gross-up because they can't reclaim VAT locally.
ora (Finance): Distributor involvement matters. If Redwood is the direct importer of services (we contract Meridian), reverse charge applies and vendor should issue net invoice. If theres a local reseller billing you, they might charge PPN legitimately. Do we have the PO/contract?
hana (Legal): Please attach the contract and any SOW that shows who the contracting party is. Also need the distributor invoice chain. If Redwood is paying Meridian directly and service delivered to ID, we may have an obligation to self-assess PPN and report to DJP. I'll loop in external Indonesian counsel if docs look ambiguous.
diego (Accounting): Action: hold payment until vendor clarifies. If vendor insists on gross-up, we need legal approval and updated PO showing total landed cost. Gross-up calc must show gross = net / (1 - tax_rate) or vendor's formula; be explicit.
tax_bot: Attachments missing: invoice PDF and distributor invoice. Please attach or we'll auto-tag as info_missing.
raj_supplier (Vendor): Uploading invoice and distributor contact now. We do not have PKP. Distributor is PT DataWrap (local). They handled onboarding for Meridian in ID.
nora (Finance): Ok, ask distributor for their NPWP/PKP and for a resale invoice. If PT DataWrap is billing Redwood or invoicing Meridian and collecting PPN, we need that paper trail.
hana (Legal): Note on withholding: Indonesia also has PPh withholding regimes for payments to nonresidents (PPh 26). That is separate from PPN. If the service is royalty/tech-related, withholding could apply. We need supplier residence certificate and classification of the service to determine PPh treatment.
diego (Accounting): Checklist for vendor: 1) proof of PKP/NPWP for any local party 2) statement of foreign tax residence + tax residency cert (if claiming treaty) 3) clarified invoice (net-only) or distributor invoice showing PPN was charged downstream.
raj_supplier (Vendor): I'll ask distributor for NPWP and reseller invoice. Also asking Meridian if they can reissue net invoice.
nora (Finance): We'll block AP. Please cc legal on vendor replies. If counsel says reverse charge applies, accounting must self-assess PPN in the month of service and record VAT payable/receivable accordingly.
tax_bot: AP hold flag created: TAX_HOLD_1825006789.
diego (Accounting): If we end up self-assessing, I'll prepare a tentative journal entry template: Dr Expense (gross excl VAT), Dr VAT Input (same amount), Cr VAT Payable, Cr Bank (net paid) — tweak once counsel confirms.
hana (Legal): If vendor insists on gross-up and distributor won't provide docs, escalate to FP for approval. Also consider negotiating to split any additional tax burden.
raj_supplier (Vendor): Update: distributor provided NPWP and a reseller invoice showing PPN collected. Meridian says they billed PPN at distributor's request.
nora (Finance): Received. Forwarding to our Indonesian counsel for confirmation whether that's sufficient or if reverse-charge/self-assess still required. Will update when counsel replies.
diego (Accounting): Thanks. Keeping ledger flagged.
raj_supplier (Vendor): Thanks all. Hoping to avoid reissue but will comply if needed. :slightly_smiling_face:
nora (Finance): Prefer short confirmation chain in email: distributor NPWP + reseller invoice + statement that Redwood is payer or not. Counsel will determine next step.
tax_bot: Thread auto-closed for updates pending counsel.
